limits: Synthetic contacts from a stand-in detector, not a validated ship detector on real SAR. The rates measure the matching and coverage logic, not detection quality.
A source vessel may have left the scene before acquisition. Same-scene ship detection cannot recover a contact absent from the image; the correct output in that situation stays unknown source.
These are simulated hiding experiments. They are not evidence about real intentional non-broadcasting by any vessel.
Neighbouring broadcast density is a weak proxy for reception quality; sparse traffic cannot establish good or bad coverage.
